# ThreadListOrder

How a thread listing is ordered.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in requests.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Newest"` | Newest first. |
| `"Weight"` | Heaviest first. |
| `"RecentlyAccessed"` | Most recently recalled or used first. |
| `"MostFrayed"` | Most frayed first. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.
